name: ironworks
description: Development pipeline: 12 skills across 7 layers -- from project bootstrap to deploy preflight, with spec-driven features, TDD, knowledge graphs, architecture analysis, and structured debugging.

interface.longDescription: Twelve original skills covering the full development lifecycle: project bootstrapping, codebase understanding via knowledge graphs, spec-driven feature planning, TDD workflows, structured debugging, architecture analysis, smart code reviews, codebase audits, deployment preflight, platform deploy configs, and session handoffs. Built on a layered architecture where each layer composes with the others.
